caption: The drawing features a cylindrical container with rounded shoulders and a straight neck topped by a flat, circular cap. The entire object appears to be rendered in shades of grey and black, resembling a graphite or ink illustration on a beige textured background. The main body of the container is decorated with embossed botanical motifs, including detailed leaves, large flowers, buds, and berries. The surface detailing emphasizes the overlapping foliage, creating a dense, textured appearance. The top and bottom edges of the container are delineated by horizontal bands. At the bottom right of the image, the word “Stewart” is written in small, simple lettering.
title: Silver Whiskey Flask
